import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353L;
    static final long MODD = 1000000007L;
    static final long INF = 1000000000000000000L;
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static final int[] st = new int[15];
    static final List<String>[] lenn = new List[7];
    static final List<List<Integer>>[] ok = new List[7][7];
    static final long[][] sum = new long[7][7];
    static final String[] good = new String[MAXN];
    static int N;
    static long number = 1;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            lenn[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                ok[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        N = String.valueOf(n).length();
        
        st[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) {
            st[i] = st[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        
        String s = String.valueOf(n);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            good[i] = String.valueOf(i);
            String now = good[i];
            while (now.length() <= 6) {
                lenn[now.length()].add(now);
                now = "0" + now;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            for (String key : lenn[i - 1]) {
                lenn[i].add(key);
            }
            Collections.sort(lenn[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < lenn[i].size(); ++j) {
                String key = lenn[i].get(j);
                int val = (j - Integer.parseInt(key) + (int)MOD) % (int)MOD;
                ok[i][key.length()].add(val);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                Collections.sort(ok[i][j]);
                for (int val : ok[i][j]) {
                    sum[i][j] += val;
                }
            }
        }
        
        List<Pair> Q = new ArrayList<>();
        String cur = "";
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 9; ++j) {
                if (j == s.charAt(i) - '0') continue;
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                cur += (char)('0' + j);
                if (j <= s.charAt(i) - '0') {
                    Q.add(new Pair(cur, s.length() - i - 1));
                } else {
                    Q.add(new Pair(cur, s.length() - i - 2));
                }
                cur = cur.substring(0, cur.length() - 1);
            }
            cur += s.charAt(i);
            Q.add(new Pair(cur, 0));
        }
        
        number = 1;
        long ans = 0;
        Collections.sort(Q, (a, b) -> a.s.compareTo(b.s));
        
        for (Pair key : Q) {
            if (s.charAt(key.s.length() - 1) == key.s.charAt(key.s.length() - 1)) {
                ans = (ans + (-goal(key.s) + number + MOD * MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
                number += 1;
                continue;
            }
            ans = (ans + get(key.s, key.max_len)) % MOD;
        }
        
        ans %= MODD;
        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }

    static int goal(String s) {
        int answ = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            answ = answ * 10 + s.charAt(i) - '0';
        }
        return answ;
    }

    static long get(String cur, int max_len) {
        if (max_len == -1) return 0;
        int L = max_len / 2;
        int R = max_len - L;
        if (max_len == 1) {
            L = 1;
            R = 0;
        }
        
        long ans = (number - goal(cur) + MOD * MOD) % MOD;
        number++;
        
        for (String lef : lenn[L]) {
            ans = (ans + (-goal(cur + lef) + number + MOD * MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
            number++;
            if (lef.length() == L) {
                int c = goal(cur + lef) % (int)MOD;
                for (int oth = 1; oth <= R; ++oth) {
                    int cnst = ((-c * st[oth]) % MOD + number + MOD * MOD) % MOD;
                    int to = lowerBound(ok[R][oth], cnst);
                    ans = (ans + (long)ok[R][oth].size() * cnst + sum[R][oth] - MOD * ((long)ok[R][oth].size() - to)) % MOD;
                }
                number += lenn[R].size();
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < target) {
                low = mid + 1;
            } else {
                high = mid;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static class Pair {
        String s;
        int max_len;
        
        Pair(String s, int max_len) {
            this.s = s;
            this.max_len = max_len;
        }
    }
}
